description: Dots routing requires bias and scaling values that construction permits to be absent. At290 the selectable DS3 route shares the optional-bias/scaling requirements and additionally requires valid grouping inputs.
trigger: Enable deepseekv3_routing with n_group=topk_group=1 but leave correction bias or routed_scaling_factor as None. At290 select dots or ds3 without bias/scaling; DS3 also needs group counts compatible with reshape and two experts per selected group.
expected_behavior: Validate required inputs or provide supported defaults.
actual_behavior: routing_dots unconditionally adds the bias and uses the scaling factor in tensor arithmetic, without a guard or fallback. Neither inspected built-in constructor enables this route. At290 both routes unconditionally use bias and scaling; DS3 reshapes by groups and takes topk(2). Dots1 supplies scale and a single group but optional bias; no built-in architecture selects DS3.
